author: sonnet
label: c2-seed-sonnet-01
changes: Rewrote the document in the skill's order: summary with how checkout works today, terms, rules, diagram, numbered steps, failure table, open questions.

Added the brief's fixed facts that the first version lacked: 202 with order ID, outbox written in the same transaction, relay 500 ms oldest-first ack-then-mark, at-least-once, topic keyed by order ID with eventId/orderId/type, separate databases and consumer groups, retry 1s/10s/60s then DLQ and paging, nothing undone, card provider decline versus timeout/5xx, best-effort email, only Order Service changes status.

Added the decisions the brief left open: duplicates handled by a per-consumer processed-events table written in the same transaction; Inventory and Payment publish through their own outbox and relay; Payment uses orderId as the idempotency key and reuses it on retries; Order Service learns the outcome by consuming StockUnavailable, PaymentCaptured and PaymentDeclined and then writes OrderConfirmed or OrderCancelled; Notification emails on OrderConfirmed and OrderCancelled; Inventory releases the reservation on PaymentDeclined.
Expanded the diagram to cover the happy path and both cancellation paths with alt blocks, adding the card provider and notes showing where state is written.
Replaced the vague 'usual retries and a DLQ' and 'consumers are idempotent' with exact behaviour in steps and a failure table.
Cut the repeated unhappy-paths paragraph and the one-line parts list, now covered by the terms and diagram.
Separated how the system runs from rollout, and noted that rollout is a separate plan.
Added two open questions: DLQ replay is undecided, and an order stuck at PENDING after a DLQ entry is not cancelled automatically, as the brief says nothing else is undone.
